name: Mount Nimba Strict Nature Reserve
description: Mount Nimba is a forested mountain range where Guinea and Côte d'Ivoire meet (the range also reaches into Liberia), rising from the savannah to Mount Richard-Molard, 1,752 metres high. Dense forest cloaks the lower slopes, giving way to open grassy uplands. The reserve shelters species found almost nowhere else, including live-bearing toads, and chimpanzees that crack nuts with stones. It is listed as in danger.
